list_requests.description: Read the public records requests created in NextRequest on or after a date, oldest first, with each one's number, what was asked for, its due date and its state.

requests.text: All police incident reports for 400 Main St in September 2026.

list_requests.name: list_requests

parameters.description: Only requests created on this date or later, such as the date a week ago.
parameters.name: created_since

closed.description: True once the request is closed in NextRequest.

due_date.description: The date NextRequest has the response due, as YYYY-MM-DD. Empty when it has none.

number.description: The request's number in NextRequest, such as 26-145.

received.description: The date the request was received, as YYYY-MM-DD.

state.description: The request's state in NextRequest, such as Open or Overdue.

url.description: The request's page in NextRequest, for staff to open.

description: Read the public records requests residents file in your NextRequest portal, with each one's number, due date and state.
